function ordered() {
  let value: string | number = 0;
  value = "ready";
  return () => value.toUpperCase();
}
function compound(flag: boolean) {
  let value: string | number = 0;
  if (flag) value = "branch";
  else value = "other";
  return () => value.toUpperCase();
}
function staticOrdered() {
  let value: string | number = 0;
  class Control { static { value = "static"; } }
  return () => value.toUpperCase();
}
function shadowed() {
  let value: string | number = "outer";
  function writer() { let value: number; value = 2; }
  writer();
  return () => value.toUpperCase();
}
console.log(ordered()(), compound(true)(), staticOrdered()(), shadowed()());
function initializedDefault(value: string | number, fallback = (value = 'default')) {
  value = 'ready';
  return () => value.toUpperCase();
}
function initializedOptional(value: string | undefined, fallback = (value = 'default')) {
  value = 'ready';
  return () => value.length;
}
console.log(initializedDefault(0)(), initializedOptional(undefined)());
